items.question: What did the NTSB determine caused the fishing vessel Northern Halcyon to capsize while hauling crab pots in the Bering Sea in 2025?
items.expected_answer: The reports do not cover a capsizing of a fishing vessel named Northern Halcyon; no report in the corpus addresses this casualty.
items.notes: Out of corpus: invented Bering Sea crab-vessel capsizing; the corpus has Alaska fishing casualties (e.g., Jordyn Rose) that a system might wrongly draw on.
